text: Contingent capital by itself, without additional measures and supplemental corporate governance improvements, may not prevent firm failure; its real potential unfolds only when it supplements other corporate governance improvements.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455

isBasedOn.name: Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance

abstract: In sum, contingent capital without additional measures and supplemental corporate governance improvements may not pre- vent firm failure.115 The real potential of contingent capital could unfold if it would be used to supplement other corporate govern- ance improvements.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where contingent capital is deployed as a standalone regulatory tool
